findings.title: An already consumed pending regeneration becomes runnable after a newer request
findings.expected: Every consumed request stays stale; repeat causes no draw, commit, document/history change or old rollback.
findings.actual: lastPendingRegen stores only most recently executed request. A executes, B replaces ref, then captured A passes identity guard and executes using old render state/backup. Classic appends transaction; Mythic can replace newer kingdom and restore older undo stack.
steps: Seed0, locality; select classic or Mythic and generate one unit.
Request regenerate A; capture current finishPendingRegeneration closure; run it and finish kingdom if any.
Request and finish regenerate B. Save full JSON except savedAt and both histories.
Invoke captured A closure again; finish kingdom if any; compare document, RNG and histories.
findings.requested_change: Make consumed pending request identity/freshness permanent for App lifetime, analogous to consumed kingdom-job protection; prevent stale request from launching generation or restoring old backup. Add bounded A→B→captured A regression in both modes comparing exact document, both RNG and both histories with no new draw; exercise after undo/redo as relevant. No history export or new UI is requested.
findings.reachability_limit: Production handler closure regression; no claim of ordinary physical UI automatically retaining and replaying that old closure.
